team_members.major_contribution: Designed and implemented the GPA Engine, interactive calculation trace viewer, office checking list, and TanStack Start UI

major_design_decisions: Engine isolated in src/lib/gpaEngine.ts (evaluateStudent/evaluateCase pure functions) for 100% testability and exact board-rule compliance (R-10/R-11/R-12/R-13/R-29)
Trace data structure captures mark used, grade point, governing rule (R-*) and failureReason plus uncancelledGpa for high-average failures
Fully client-side (no backend) with file upload for P08_school_results_public.json and bundled 80-student default dataset covering all 4 hard-edge categories
